direct: hooks.SessionStart=[{matcher='^(startup|resume)$',hooks=[{type='command',command='[ -n "$NAVIDE_CODEX_LAUNCH" ] || exit 0; navide_port=$(cat "$NAVIDE_CODEX_PORT_FILE" 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$navide_port" ] || exit 0; curl -fsS -m 2 -o /dev/null -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "@$NAVIDE_CODEX_AUTH_FILE" -H "X-Navide-Codex-Launch: $NAVIDE_CODEX_LAUNCH" --data-binary @- "http://127.0.0.1:$navide_port/hooks/codex/session-start" 2>/dev/null || true',timeout=3}]}]
